lessons_used: Predictions were generally too high, except for the pet companion redesign where the prediction was too low.
Redesigning the grid view pet companion was helpful.
Reordering the onboarding flow to narrative-first performed significantly worse.
Deferring sign-in after adoption showed no clear effect.
Adding hints, shortcut guides, desktop notification prompts, or tip carousels showed no clear effect.
Simplifying the path choice layout showed no clear effect.

candidates.title: Account Recovery and Existing Pet Sync Notice
candidates.change: Redesign the sign-in screen options to prominent account status choices and clear warnings regarding multi-account pet loss.
candidates.why: Support receives 8 emails about pets missing or reset after signing in with a different account during setup.

sign_in.headline: Sign In to Sync Your Pet Companion
sign_in.body: Use your primary account so your companion and past adoptions stay linked.

sign_in_options.text: Signing in ensures your desktop companion is backed up safely.
Important: Sign in with your original account to retrieve existing pets

guard.reason: 'sign_in.replace.sign_in_options[1]': a badge cannot do the sign_in_options job (use ['button', 'choice_cards', 'image', 'text'])

candidates.title: Custom Photo Quality Validation Stage
candidates.change: Insert a new photo validation screen immediately after photo upload to verify image clarity and pet outlines before custom generation.
candidates.why: Support reported 3 issues where custom pet generation failed or resulted in distorted graphics, causing adoption stalls.

new_photo_check.headline: Check Photo Quality
new_photo_check.body: Ensure your pet photo is clear and well-lit for accurate desktop rendering.

components.text: Single pet in frame, Good lighting, Sharp focus

guard.reason: Valid addition of a photo quality check screen inside onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Adding a new screen adds friction; evidence comes mainly from support rather than the funnel.

candidates.title: Desktop Spawn Test Stage
candidates.change: Add a dedicated desktop render test screen right after waiting to confirm the pet window displays properly on screen.
candidates.why: Support received 3 emails where pets failed to show on the desktop or the app stalled upon launching to the desktop.

new_desktop_test.headline: Testing Desktop Window Rendering
new_desktop_test.body: Verifying display permissions and desktop overlay compatibility for your pet.

components.text: Click below if your pet is visible on your screen background.

guard.reason: Valid addition of a desktop window render test screen inside onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Extra test step increases flow drop-off with low confidence of positive impact.

candidates.title: Interactive Adoption Certificate Showcase
candidates.change: Redesign the adoption certificate screen into a spotlight layout showcasing the companion's assigned personality traits.
candidates.why: Adoption step has a 1017s mean time and 73.1% conversion rate, indicating friction before final confirmation.

adoption_certificate.headline: Meet Your Official Companion
adoption_certificate.body: Your companion certificate is ready with custom attributes and personality.

guard.reason: 'adoption_certificate.replace.certificate[0]': a mascot cannot do the certificate job (use ['animation', 'badge', 'image', 'preview', 'text'])

candidates.title: Full-Bleed Animated Story Prologue
candidates.change: Redesign the initial story screen into a full-bleed animated intro presenting the world of desktop pets.
candidates.why: Choose path step has a high mean time of 514s and drop-off rate of nearly 24%.

story.headline: Welcome to Your New Desktop Life
story.body: Discover AI companions that live, react, and play right on your monitor screen.

guard.reason: replacement for 'story.intro_story' does not do the job: needs 1 of ['animation', 'image', 'mascot', 'video'] with an asset:story/ asset

candidates.title: Background Generation Audio Notification
candidates.change: Add an audio completion chime and explicit notify toggle on the waiting screen when companion generation finishes.
candidates.why: The waiting screen has an exceptionally long mean duration of 2336s (nearly 39 minutes) as users tab away.

waiting.headline: Generating Your Pet Companion...
waiting.body: Feel free to minimize this window. We will play a sound when your pet arrives.

guard.reason: Valid enhancement to the waiting screen with notification sound and status details.

candidates.score_note: Funnel clearly shows extreme 39-minute wait time; wait_info changes previously yielded +3.5%.

candidates.title: Pick Friend Character Selection Split View
candidates.change: Switch the character selection screen layout to split view featuring side-by-side animated companion previews.
candidates.why: Adoption target step conversion drops to 73.1% with long decision times during pet selection.

pick_friend.headline: Choose Your Desktop Companion
pick_friend.body: Select a friend style to bring onto your screen.

pet_choices.text: Classic Pixel Pet vs 3D Desktop Buddy

guard.reason: Valid layout update for picking a friend while preserving pet selection functionality.

candidates.score_note: Adoption redesigns previously showed strong +17.5% lift and target step has high drop-off and duration.

candidates.title: Path Choice Value Proposition Cards
candidates.change: Reformat the path selection screen layout to two-column cards comparing custom pet creation against pre-made companion selection.
candidates.why: 23.8% of users drop off at choose_path, spending a median of 8s but mean of 514s due to confusion between pathways.

choose_path.headline: Select How You Want to Adopt
choose_path.body: Upload your own photo or pick from ready-to-play desktop companions.

path_options.text: Custom Creation: Unique pet built from photo

guard.reason: replacement for 'choose_path.path_options' does not do the job (two distinct choices: adopting a friend and making your own): needs 2 of ['button', 'choice_cards'] with real words

candidates.title: Home Intro Stage Greeting Presentation
candidates.change: Redesign home_intro into a stage layout featuring an interactive companion greeting animation and completion checklist.
candidates.why: The final completion step has the lowest conversion rate (64.8%) and a mean completion time of 5815s.

home_intro.headline: Your Companion Has Arrived!
home_intro.body: Your pet is now active on your computer screen. Click below to start interacting.

guard.reason: replacement for 'home_intro.home_welcome' does not do the job: needs 1 of ['animation', 'image', 'mascot', 'text'] with real words

candidates.title: Finish Step Desktop Visibility Status Banner
candidates.change: Add a highlighted status banner to the home intro screen detailing how to locate and activate the desktop companion overlay.
candidates.why: 3 support tickets reported pets not displaying on desktop and 3 tickets asked how to control or hide the pet post-onboarding.

home_intro.headline: Setup Complete - Pet is Active
home_intro.body: Look at your desktop taskbar and screen corners to find your companion.
home_intro.hint: Tip: Right-click your pet on screen anytime to access controls, settings, or hide it.

components.text: Active on Desktop Taskbar & Main Screen

guard.reason: Valid addition of visibility status banner and helpful hint to home intro screen.

candidates.score_note: Finish step has highest drop-off and strong support evidence, but hint changes historically showed negative or no effect.

picked: Finish Step Desktop Visibility Status Banner

decisions.title: Finish Step Desktop Visibility Status Banner

lessons_next: Predictions were generally too high, except for the pet companion redesign where the prediction was too low.

Adding a new validation stage screen performed significantly worse.
